notes: Self-declared Open-World RPG and it behaves like one - levels, loot rarity, three classes with skill trees, and a boss per region - so RPG leads alone; the heavy melee/ranged combat detail is what the Action RPG preset is already for, so it earns no second genre. Shape is world-open-biomes for the four themed mega-regions around the Nexus Palace, swapped in over that preset's world-hub-dungeon because the prompt says seamless and the shape answer confirms one continuous surface with no instanced areas; that same statement is the documented override of the shape's P4, so this routes as one map. P2 and P3 are not assumptions but stated features - accessible underground slums beneath the city, sky-lane and cloud-platform layers above it, and a palace hub and slum district you go into - and the CHECK is the bioluminescent rivers plus the floating-island volume, which only bites if those layers self-occlude. Dropped the survival preset's buildzone-plot on the strength of the base-building answer, kept social-hub bent to the Nexus Palace as the neutral quest and economy cluster, and noted here rather than as an option that the four world bosses fight in the open biomes rather than in arenas of their own.
